events.title: Stage 1-15 Progress Fix & Difficulty Adjustments
events.summary: Fixed an issue on Stage 1-15 in Chapter 1 where, on the 2nd turn, you could no longer progress if you had no stars left and couldn’t change the dice values.Adjusted the difficulty of some stages.A heartfelt thank you to 蝶音 紳紅【しんくch】 (@SinkuCH), who played the demo on a live stream and helped us discover this bug.Sorry for the inconvenience. If you run into any problems, please let us know anytime. Thank you!

events.title: Hint System Update
events.summary: We've changed the hint system we added last time so that it's available starting from Chapter 2.Hints are available from Chapter 2 onward.Silver coins appear on screen once Chapter 2 unlocks. You still earn silver coins for first-time stage clears in Chapter 1.The Hint and Record buttons appear the first time you replay a stage you've cleared.🎮 Demo The demo only includes Chapter 1, so hints and silver coins don't appear there. Silver coins you earn in the demo carry over to the full game.

events.title: Hint System & Silver Coins
events.summary: Hi, this is Dice Tiny Town! We've added a hint system for stages where a perfect clear 🍎 just won't come together.🪙 Earning Silver CoinsClear a stage for the first time: 1 silver coinFinish a Challenge Mode run: 2 silver coins, with more for going past the trophy scoreYour play from before this update earns silver coins too.💡 Three Hint Steps On any stage you've cleared, the "Hint" button at the top shows how to get a perfect clear, one step at a time.
